card.name: Linking words before diuretics and heart drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, with, by, and) that come just before a named drug class such as diuretics, digitalis or ACE inhibitors. They appear in heart failure treatment and dosing sentences.

modes.label: Dose of diuretics
modes.description: The word 'of' after dose or doses, right before diuretics or another drug name.
modes.example: should be treated by an increase in the dose<< of>> diuretics.

modes.label: Add-on or combined therapy
modes.description: 'to', 'with', 'by' or 'and' linking heart failure to a co-given drug such as digitalis or ACE inhibitors.
modes.example: In some cases, beta-blocker therapy can be continued while heart failure is treated<< with>> other drugs.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name a drug class next, though the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words just before a heart-failure drug such as a diuretic or digitalis is named.
